about: Model provider falsifiers: each entry breaks one check (exact text, replaced once), and every named test must then FAIL. Run with examples/agent-host/falsify.py --list capsules/model-provider/falsifiers.json. expect: caught (all named tests fail), compile_error (the mutation must not build), survives (known survivor, by design). Edit paths are relative to examples/agent-host, as in the host list. command: provider (cargo test --locked of this crate, through its own manifest and Cargo.lock).

falsifiers.title: a derived journal root names the wrong folder
